text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You again? Look, annoying. Why come this far?
choice_data_list: I want to you to hear me out
I want to you to hear me out

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm nothing. Just empty display doll. That's me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Modeling fun at first. Expressions, poses, praised when nailed it, felt proud.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Acted as expected, made persona work—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Then saw self in ad downtown one day, thought, "Who is that?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “Full of serious, doll-faced pictures... acting like some perfect beauty.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, caught on real quick. That’s “Gold City.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoever that is... that kid jumping around like crazy, that’s me too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Got totally freaked out, felt like screaming. Couldn’t sit still at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just knew I needed to run, dash like crazy, mess myself up—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then... saw it. Sunset.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ended up somewhere totally unknown. Kept tripping, legs caked in mud, favorite one-piece ruined.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sky looked ridiculously gorgeous, though. Don't even get why.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...That's when it hit me. Right now, I'm actually me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Legs burning, lungs bursting. But—right then, I was just plain “myself.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That’s why I hit up Tracen Academy. To run, run, and be “myself.” To carve proof of “Me” into everybody.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Though—
(Car Beep!)

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City! Thank goodness, here you are! Called a bunch, missed them? Time for work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Manager... Ah, bad, got caught up talking... Whoa, seriously, missed calls through the roof.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Well, glad I found you... Something happen? With that trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Something like that. Whatever, my bad, job time. Yeah, heading out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, can I swing by academy first, though? Need to book training course...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, City. Haven't you had enough? Body and mind worn down, pushed hard enough already. Aren't you... exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ……ah!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Folks only judge you by looks... Nothing can fix that. Face reality, City.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I'll make you a top model, guaranteed. Pick stage where you actually shine. Stop breaking yourself in world not built for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “World not built for me”... huh. Haha, maybe so. Felt nice daydreaming, ended up like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Man... Guess it’s about time to throw in towel.
(Engine start! Car Go Skrrr…)
Watching car drive off, spotted something dropped on ground.
Lock screen had photo of sky. Hands probably shook taking it, but sunset sky looked truly stunning.
“Wanna run and run to be myself”—Gold City’s words echoed back.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City, wait here a sec. Going to talk with staff.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm... got it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Agency's crazy good. Famous cameraman-san I recognize. Getting him to shoot gorgeous pics...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Guess... this path really fits me best...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-Wait, you... why...?
choice_data_list: I’m here to deliver your dream
I’m here to deliver your dream

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Dream...? What, totally lost here...
Showed phone screen brought over to confused Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, haaah?! Hold up, you! Why have my smartphone...?! Wait... you peeked...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, not my dream! Drop it, quitting already!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gimme that back!
Phone got snatched back violently.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Enough already, quit, done with it! This photo, deleting it right now...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gonna delete it, gonna delete it, delete it, I will...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ……Why.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why... can’t I delete it...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...What is your deal, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pissing me off. Annoying. Softie. Stalker. Thief. Phone-peeper. Zero tact. Nagging. Annoying, annoying, annoying!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Spilled my story, said I'd dump it all! Got no clue why I blabbed all that to you! Who the hell do you think you are!
choice_data_list: I’m just a trainer scouting for Gold City!
I’m just a trainer scouting for Gold City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Arghhh, shut uuup already!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then prove it, you! Be my trainer, let me run with everything I got!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Treat me like some pretty doll though, get punched in face!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “Understood,” just like that... Ugh, so annoying.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City, sorry to keep you waiting! Wait... huh? Person from earlier...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah, explain later. Work first, right... So, wait here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gonna introduce you to my worrywart manager. As my... my official trainer.
